summary: Phase 2 marketing audit verification — all 12 acceptance criteria pass. Backend: 50/50 pytest pass, including 4 new seed-seo-articles tests. Live preview API: POST /api/admin/seed-seo-articles correctly returns 401 without auth, is idempotent on repeat calls (skipped=5, inserted=0), overwrites with ?force=true (updated=5). GET /api/articles?limit=20 returns 11 articles total — all 5 new SEO slugs present, each with word_count > 1000 (1118-1547). Direct article fetch (/api/articles/what-does-moon-in-scorpio…) returns intact markdown containing 'Moon in Scorpio' and internal links to /birth-chart and /synastry. Frontend: /vs/nebula, /vs/co-star, /free-no-signup all render new H1, two working CTAs (navigated to /birth-chart), 8-row comparison grid, 5-question FAQ, 6 JSON-LD scripts each (Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, WebPage). /birth-chart now has HowTo JSON-LD with exactly 5 steps ('How to Calculate Your Free Birth Chart'). All 6 /sign-calculators/{sun,moon,rising,mercury,venus,mars} each carry HowTo JSON-LD with exactly 4 steps. Synastry happy-path (Ada 1990-06-15, Charles 1985-11-30): share section + card render with both names, signs (Gemini & Sagittarius), 45% compatibility ring, native-share + copy buttons present; Copy button correctly transitions 'Copy text' → 'Copied!'. Admin /admin Articles tab shows both 'Seed defaults' and 'Seed SEO articles' (data-testid='admin-articles-seed-seo-btn'). Zero console errors across all new pages.
critical_code_review_comments: VsPage.tsx: clean, reusable. data-testid is parameterised with competitorTag (vs-nebula-*, vs-co-star-*, vs-no-signup-*). Note: review_request brief mentioned the literal id 'vs-marketing-audit-impl-cta-top' which is a transcription artefact (uses preview hostname instead of competitor tag) — the actual implementation correctly uses competitor tags, which is the right design.

VsPage comparison table is rendered as a div grid (not <table>/<tr>) — fine for layout/a11y if proper roles are added, but plain HTML <table> would surface better in screen readers and SEO. Consider promoting to semantic <table> markup with <caption>.
seo_articles.py: 5 articles, each >1000 words, all carry internal links to /birth-chart and /synastry — good for internal link graph + topical clustering.
seed-seo-articles endpoint is properly admin-gated, idempotent by default, and supports ?force=true override — matches behaviour of the existing seed-defaults endpoint.

SynastryShareCard: renders both names + sign labels + percent ring inside a single capture-friendly card; Share button uses navigator.share when available; Copy fallback transitions to 'Copied!' state correctly.
howToSchema() builder used consistently in App.tsx for BirthChartPage (5 steps) and PlanetCalculatorRoute (4 steps); JSON-LD validates cleanly in document.head.
Pre-existing modality % bug from iteration_1 (1100%/2233%) is now fixed — not retested explicitly in this iteration but the fix was noted in the review_request as 'already been applied'.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created — the 5 SEO articles were already in db (per review_request note). POST /api/admin/seed-seo-articles was exercised in idempotent mode (skipped=5) and force mode (updated=5); article count remains 11.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 2 changes verified end-to-end. To re-run: (1) backend pytest is `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v`; (2) the 3 VS pages live at /vs/nebula, /vs/co-star, /free-no-signup with data-testids vs-{nebula|co-star|no-signup}-cta-{top|bottom}; (3) Synastry quirk: form has 4 selects (P1+P2 month+day) and 4 inputs in .glass-card (2 names + 2 number-type year inputs).
